svg.title: LinkPulse architecture: a request through the ingress to the Go service and DynamoDB, watched, deployed by ArgoCD from CI
svg.desc: Request path: the user reaches the ingress over TLS (Traefik locally, an ALB on EKS), then the Go service, which the HPA scales between 2 and 6 pods, then one DynamoDB table. Inside the Kubernetes cluster (k3d locally, EKS on AWS), Prometheus scrapes the service and evaluates 13 alert rules, Alertmanager sends alerts to Discord, Grafana shows 3 dashboards over Prometheus and Loki, and Alloy ships pod logs to Loki. ArgoCD deploys the cluster as an app of apps. Five chaos experiments induce the failures the alerts claim to catch; Terraform builds four environments. On every push, GitHub Actions runs the tests and an end-to-end run on k3d, Trivy gates the image, the image is pushed to ghcr.io, and a bot commit pins it in the aws overlay, which ArgoCD picks up from git.
svg.text: Kubernetes: k3d locally, EKS on AWS
